<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Rafael Morales González — PhD researcher and R&D innovation leader working across European funding, human–computer interaction, ultrasound, haptics and emerging technologies.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
<title>Rafael Morales — Technology & Innovation Leadership</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#182b3c;
  --muted:#64778a;
  --paper:#ffffff;
  --white:#fff;
  --blue:#497fa5;
  --blue-deep:#356f99;
  --rule:#dfe8ef;
  --soft:#f3f8fc;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #79b6db;outline-offset:4px}
p{line-height:1.72;margin-top:0}h1,h2,h3{font-family:Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin-top:0}.container{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 88px));margin:auto}
.nav-shell{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:30}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:28px 0}.wordmark{font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.07em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}.navlinks{display:flex;gap:30px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.095em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}.navlinks a:hover,.text-link:hover{color:#d9edf9}.nav .contact-nav{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);padding:12px 17px;border-radius:50px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);backdrop-filter: blur(10px)}
.hero-banner{position:relative;min-height:76vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#dcecf6 0%,#bfd8ea 100%)}
.hero-banner img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}.hero-banner::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,38,53,.10) 0%,rgba(17,38,53,.14) 36%,rgba(17,38,53,.42) 100%)}
.banner-fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#4d7894;text-align:center;padding:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#eef6fb,#dbeaf4 55%,#c7deec)}.banner-fallback strong{font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);display:block;color:#335a76;margin-bottom:12px}.banner-fallback span{font-size:15px;max-width:420px}
.hero-panel-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;padding:0 0 54px}.hero-panel{width:min(880px,calc(100% - 24px));background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter: blur(14px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(31,58,84,.14);border-radius:24px;padding:34px 36px}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.19em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}.hero-panel h1{font-size:clamp(50px,6.2vw,90px);line-height:.96;margin:18px 0 24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}.hero-panel .lead{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,34px);max-width:720px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin-bottom:18px}.hero-panel .sub{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);max-width:690px}.button-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}.button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 25px;background:var(--blue-deep);border:1px solid var(--blue-deep);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:50px;transition:transform .2s,background .2s}.button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#245679}.button.secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--blue-deep);border-color:#bad1e1}.button.secondary:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.quickfacts{margin-top:-26px;position:relative;z-index:10}.metrics{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 55px rgba(25,56,81,.08)}.metrics-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.metric{padding:30px 28px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}.metric:last-child{border-right:0}.metric strong{font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(30px,3.8vw,52px);line-height:1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.06em;display:block;margin-bottom:10px}.metric span{font-size:13px;color:#557187}
.section{padding:105px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}.section-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.48fr 1fr;gap:56px;margin-bottom:56px}.section h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,68px);line-height:1.08;font-weight:750;margin:0}.section-copy{max-width:790px}.section-copy p{font-size:19px;color:#35495a;line-height:1.72}.section-copy p + p{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted)}.text-link{display:inline-flex;margin-top:14px;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:5px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:19px}.card{background:#fff;min-height:315px;padding:33px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border:1px solid #dfeaf2;border-radius:10px}.card .num{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700}.card h3{font-size:29px;line-height:1.19;margin:18px 0}.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}.card .tag{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue)}
.work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}.work{min-height:300px;padding:34px;background:#e8f2f9;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-radius:10px}.work:nth-child(2){background:#f0f4f8}.work:nth-child(3){background:#e6eff6}.work:nth-child(4){background:#eef5fa}.work h3{font-size:36px;line-height:1.14;margin:10px 0}.work p{max-width:430px;font-size:15px;color:#516779}.work .tag{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}
.timeline{max-width:820px;margin-left:auto}.timeline-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:25px;padding:29px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}.timeline-item:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}.timeline-year{font-size:12px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em}.timeline h3{font-size:25px;margin:0 0 8px}.timeline p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.contact-section{background:#edf6fb;color:var(--ink);padding:90px 0}.contact-section h2{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,93px);max-width:850px;line-height:1.07}.contact-section p{color:#536e82;max-width:600px}.footer{background:#17354d;color:#d7e6f1}.footer-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:28px 0;font-size:12px;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}.footer a:hover{color:#fff}
@media(max-width:920px){.container{width:min(100% - 48px,1180px)}.navlinks{gap:14px}.hero-banner{min-height:68vh}.hero-panel{padding:28px}.section-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}.section{padding:80px 0}.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.cards .card:last-child{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:260px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.container{width:calc(100% - 36px)}.nav{padding:20px 0}.wordmark{font-size:17px}.navlinks{gap:13px;font-size:10px}.navlinks a:not(.contact-nav){display:none}.nav .contact-nav{padding:10px}.hero-banner{min-height:74vh}.hero-panel-wrap{padding-bottom:26px}.hero-panel{border-radius:18px;padding:22px 20px;width:100%}.hero-panel h1{font-size:clamp(42px,13vw,70px)}.hero-panel .lead{font-size:24px}.hero-panel .sub{font-size:15px}.quickfacts{margin-top:-8px}.metrics-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.metric{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}.metric:last-child{border-bottom:0}.cards,.work-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cards .card:last-child{grid-column:auto}.card{min-height:255px}.work{min-height:260px}.section{padding:65px 0}.section-head{margin-bottom:34px}.timeline-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.contact-section{padding:70px 0}.footer-inner{line-height:1.7}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*,*:before,*:after{transition:none!important}}

/* Redesigned full-width original artwork header */
.nav-shell{position:relative;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.wordmark,.navlinks{color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
.nav .contact-nav{border-color:#bad1e1;background:#f3f8fc;color:#356f99}
.navlinks a:hover{color:#356f99}
.identity-banner{background:#fff;width:100%;overflow:hidden}
.identity-banner img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
.intro{padding:70px 0 78px}
.intro h1{font-size:clamp(38px,5.5vw,78px);line-height:1.1;max-width:1040px;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:18px 0 22px}
.intro-description{max-width:820px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,22px);line-height:1.68;color:var(--muted)}
.quickfacts{margin-top:0}
.advisory-section{background:#f3f8fc}
.advisory-lead{font-size:19px;color:#526579;max-width:820px;margin-bottom:35px}
.service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px;margin:32px 0}
.service-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:30px;min-height:210px}
.service-card h3{font-size:25px;line-height:1.25;margin:14px 0}
.service-card p{color:#64778a;font-size:15px;margin:0}
@media(max-width:640px){.intro{padding:45px 0 55px}.intro h1{font-size:clamp(34px,9vw,52px)}.service-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.service-card{min-height:auto}.navlinks .contact-nav{padding:10px}.identity-banner img{min-height:105px}}


/* Project photography: user-supplied originals, 2-column editorial cards */
.visual-work-grid{align-items:stretch;gap:26px}
.visual-work{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfebf3;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(42,88,121,.045);transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease}
.visual-work:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 17px 42px rgba(42,88,121,.11)}
.project-media{height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#f4f9fc}
.project-media img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.project-media.photo img{object-fit:cover;object-position:center}
.project-media.logo{padding:48px 42px;background:#f4f9fc}
.project-media.logo img{object-fit:contain}
.project-content{padding:26px 30px 30px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.project-content .tag{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#497fa5;font-weight:700}
.project-content h3{font-size:32px;line-height:1.18;margin:13px 0}
.project-content p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;color:#526579;margin:0 0 22px}
.project-link{margin-top:auto}.project-link .text-link{margin-top:0;color:#356f99}
@media(max-width:640px){.visual-work-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}.project-media.logo{padding:34px}.project-content{padding:22px}.project-content h3{font-size:27px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.visual-work{transition:none}.visual-work:hover{transform:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="nav-shell">
  <header class="container">
    <nav class="nav" aria-label="Main navigation">
      <a class="wordmark" href="#top">RAFAEL MORALES<span style="color:#d8edf9">.</span></a>
      <div class="navlinks"><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#expertise">Expertise</a><a href="#projects">Projects</a><a href="#advisory">Advisory</a><a href="https://rafamg10.github.io/publications/">Publications</a><a class="contact-nav" href="#contact">Get in touch ↗</a></div>
    </nav>
  </header>
</div>
<main id="top">
  <section class="identity-banner" aria-label="Rafael Morales original website banner">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Rafael Morales — original illustration with smartphone and tablet showing initials R and M">
  </section>
  <section class="intro container" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
    <div class="eyebrow">PhD in Computer Science · Executive MBA Candidate</div>
    <h1 id="hero-title">Connecting technology, people, and strategy to drive innovation.</h1>
    <p class="intro-description">I bring together multidisciplinary teams, scientific expertise, and strategic vision to develop technologies and lead ambitious R&amp;D initiatives.</p>
    <div class="button-row"><a class="button" href="#projects">Explore my work ↓</a><a class="button secondary" href="#advisory">Advisory &amp; consulting ↗</a><a class="button secondary" href="https://rafamg10.github.io/cv/">View CV</a></div>
  </section>
  <div class="container quickfacts">
    <div class="metrics"><div class="metrics-grid"><div class="metric"><strong>€18M+</strong><span>European R&D funding secured</span></div><div class="metric"><strong>9+ years</strong><span>International research and innovation experience</span></div><div class="metric"><strong>PhD · EMBA</strong><span>Computer Science · Executive MBA in progress</span></div></div></div>
  </div>
  <section id="about" class="section container"><div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">01 / Biography</div><h2>From the laboratory to innovation leadership.</h2></div><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:0"><div></div><div class="section-copy"><p>I am a computer scientist and R&amp;D leader with a research background in human–computer interaction, ultrasound-based technologies and novel interfaces. My career spans academic research, experimental engineering and the development of collaborative European innovation projects.</p><p>After conducting research in France and the UK, including work at the University of Sussex and Ultraleap, I moved into leading research teams and complex European funding initiatives. I bring scientific depth, hands-on technical expertise and an increasingly strategic view of how innovation creates value.</p><p>I am currently pursuing an Executive MBA at EOI Sevilla (2026–2027), complementing my PhD with a focus on leadership, business and innovation strategy.</p><a class="text-link" href="https://rafamg10.github.io/cv/">Explore my professional background ↗</a></div></div></section>
  <section id="expertise" class="section container"><div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">02 / Expertise</div><h2>Connecting science, engineering and strategy.</h2></div><div class="cards"><article class="card"><div><span class="num">01</span><h3>R&amp;D Leadership</h3><p>Research strategy, multidisciplinary team leadership, technology roadmaps, technical coordination and innovation delivery.</p></div><span class="tag">People · Technology · Impact</span></article><article class="card"><div><span class="num">02</span><h3>European Funding</h3><p>Horizon Europe proposal development, consortium building, work-package coordination, project budgets and stakeholder collaboration.</p></div><span class="tag">Horizon Europe · Clusters 4 &amp; 5</span></article><article class="card"><div><span class="num">03</span><h3>Emerging Technologies</h3><p>Human–computer interaction, AI-enabled solutions, ultrasound haptics, acoustic levitation, XR, sensors and novel interfaces.</p></div><span class="tag">HCI · AI · Deep Tech</span></article></div></section>
  <section id="projects" class="section container"><div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">03 / Selected work</div><h2>Research with real-world ambition.</h2></div><div class="work-grid visual-work-grid">
<article class="visual-work"><div class="project-media logo"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Official SENSORAMA project logo" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div><div class="project-content"><span class="tag">European R&amp;D · Extended Reality</span><h3>SENSORAMA</h3><p>Multimodal XR training technologies combining visual, audio, haptic and adaptive feedback. Involved in winning the research proposal.</p><div class="project-link"><span class="text-link">Immersive technologies</span></div></div></article>
<article class="visual-work"><div class="project-media logo"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Official DiCiM project logo" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div><div class="project-content"><span class="tag">European R&amp;D · Digital Circular Manufacturing</span><h3>DiCiM Project</h3><p>Contributed to the development of AI-driven decision-support solutions for circular manufacturing, integrating machine learning and digital technologies to optimise product lifecycle management and value recovery.</p><div class="project-link"><a class="text-link" href="https://www.dicimproject.eu/project" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Visit project website ↗</a></div></div></article>
<article class="visual-work"><div class="project-media photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Levitating tangible notification demonstration with a hand holding a transparent film" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div><div class="project-content"><span class="tag">Research · Acoustic Levitation</span><h3>Levitate Project</h3><p>As principal investigator, I explored contactless fabrication, manipulation and interactions made possible by precisely controlled ultrasonic fields.</p><div class="project-link"><a class="text-link" href="https://rafamg10.github.io/publications/">See publications ↗</a></div></div></article>
<article class="visual-work"><div class="project-media photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hand interacting with a mid-air haptic interface and illuminated numbers" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div><div class="project-content"><span class="tag">Research · Mid-air Haptics</span><h3>TouchLessAI</h3><p>Research into mid-air haptic experiences, new interfaces and multimodal feedback without physical contact.</p><div class="project-link"><a class="text-link" href="https://rafamg10.github.io/publications/">See publications ↗</a></div></div></article>
</div></section>

  <section id="advisory" class="section advisory-section">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">04 / Advisory &amp; Consulting</div><h2>Helping organisations turn technological challenges into opportunities.</h2></div>
      <p class="advisory-lead">I support companies, research organisations and innovation-driven teams in shaping R&amp;D strategies, securing European funding and developing ambitious technology initiatives.</p>
      <div class="service-grid">
        <article class="service-card"><span class="eyebrow">01</span><h3>R&amp;D &amp; Innovation Strategy</h3><p>Innovation roadmaps, opportunity assessment and strategic R&amp;D planning.</p></article>
        <article class="service-card"><span class="eyebrow">02</span><h3>European Funding &amp; Horizon Europe</h3><p>Consortium development, proposal design, work plans and budget strategy.</p></article>
        <article class="service-card"><span class="eyebrow">03</span><h3>Technology Advisory</h3><p>Technology assessment in AI, human–computer interaction, XR and emerging interfaces.</p></article>
        <article class="service-card"><span class="eyebrow">04</span><h3>R&amp;D Leadership &amp; Delivery</h3><p>Support for multidisciplinary teams, research programmes and technical coordination.</p></article>
      </div>
      <a class="button" href="mailto:RafaelMoralesG@gmail.com?subject=Advisory%20and%20Consulting%20Inquiry">Discuss a collaboration ↗</a>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="section container" id="journey"><div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">04 / Background</div><h2>A path across research and industry.</h2></div><div class="timeline"><div class="timeline-item"><div class="timeline-year">2023 – 2026</div><div><h3>IDENER · R&amp;D Leadership</h3><p>European collaborative R&amp;D projects, proposal development, team coordination and innovation strategy.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-item"><div class="timeline-year">Prior experience</div><div><h3>Ultraleap · Principal Investigator in acoustic devices</h3><p>Applied research in novel interaction technology and mid-air haptics.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-item"><div class="timeline-year">Prior experience</div><div><h3>University of Sussex · Postdoctoral Research</h3><p>Acoustic levitation, volumetric displays and contactless interaction.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-item"><div class="timeline-year">PhD</div><div><h3>Université Paris-Saclay · Computer Science</h3><p>Human–computer interaction and tangible interfaces.</p></div></div></div></section>
  <section class="section container"><div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">05 / Research</div><h2>Curiosity is where it all began.</h2></div><div class="section-head" style="margin-bottom:0"><div></div><div class="section-copy"><p>My research has appeared in leading venues including CHI, UIST and SIGGRAPH, covering tangible interactions, contactless interfaces, ultrasonic haptics and acoustic manipulation.</p><p>Selected projects and publications include LeviPrint, UltraPower, LeviProps, TouchTokens and SkinHaptics.</p><a class="button" href="https://rafamg10.github.io/publications/">Browse publications ↗</a></div></div></section>
  <section id="contact" class="contact-section"><div class="container"><div class="eyebrow">06 / Connect</div><h2>Let's build what comes next.</h2><p>Interested in research collaboration, R&amp;D leadership, European projects or emerging technology? I'd be glad to connect.</p><div class="button-row"><a class="button" href="mailto:RafaelMoralesG@gmail.com?subject=Website%20Enquiry">Get in touch ↗</a><a class="button secondary" href="https://github.com/rafamg10" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub ↗</a></div></div></section>
</main>
<footer class="footer"><div class="container footer-inner"><span>© 2026 Rafael Morales González</span><span>Research · Innovation · Technology · Málaga, Spain</span><a href="#top">Back to top ↑</a></div></footer>
